mutation_targets.rationale: F_LeastPrivilegeOutcome is the load-bearing fact that maps disallowed (role,kind) pairs to a Denied outcome. Clearing it removes the deny-side enforcement; the injection forces an Operation whose (caller.role -> kind) is not in PermMatrix.Allowed yet whose outcome is OK, directly contradicting LeastPrivilege's 'outcome=OK implies in matrix' clause.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | (op.caller.role -> op.kind) not in PermMatrix.Allowed and op.outcome = OK }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries forbids two AuditEntry atoms recording the same (application, prev, new) triple — the structural encoding of 'no duplicates, no mutation through replacement'. Removing it lets the model invent a duplicate entry, and the injection forces exactly that, which the AppendOnly assertion is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.application = e2.application and e1.previousStatus = e2.previousStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_CustomerOwnershipForGet enforces that a customer's GetApp against an application they don't own is denied (matching the contract's 404 no-existence-leak rule). Clearing it allows successful cross-customer reads; the injection produces a customer Operation with OK outcome on someone else's application, violating OwnershipBasedAccess.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = Customer and op.kind = OpGetApp and op.outcome = OK and some op.target and op.target.customer != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_OneInFlightPerCustomer is the Alloy encoding of the partial unique index idx_one_in_flight_per_customer. Clearing it lets two in-flight applications coexist for the same customer; the injection forces such a pair, which the FR-008 assertion explicitly forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OneInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = Submitted and a2.status = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_DecideRequiresAssignedOfficer ties a successful OpDecide to the application's assigned officer (matching the conditional UPDATE … WHERE assigned_officer_id=?). Clearing it lets a non-assigned officer decide; the injection produces an OpDecide with OK outcome whose caller is not the assigned officer, breaking FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DecideAssignedViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpDecide and op.outcome = OK and some op.target and some op.target.assignedOfficer and op.target.assignedOfficer != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuditAttribution forces each audit entry's actor to match the responsible party (customer for initial, assigned officer for claim/decide). Clearing it permits misattribution; the injection creates an initial entry whose actor is not the application's customer, directly contradicting AttributionCorrectness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some e: AuditEntry | no e.previousStatus and e.newStatus = Submitted and e.actor != e.application.customer }
